symptom: The exported v0.2 formula and source-manifest digest helpers checked the shape of caller-owned objects before rereading their fields. A later own-descriptor Proxy trap could repair an initially invalid formula expression or evidence stage before hashing, so standalone callers could receive a digest for a later claim rather than the entry-time metadata.
lesson: A direct exported digest API is its own trust boundary. Fixing the reconciler does not pin standalone digest inputs: a descriptor-only shape check cannot guarantee that later property reads represent the same claim.
guardrail: Snapshot the complete bounded own-data-descriptor input graph before any standalone formula or source-manifest digest validation/hash; return null for malformed or mutated initial claims. Regression tests must execute the late repair traps and still reject; never treat a matching digest as independent authority.
